names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Κρονανός o εξ Ιρλανδίας», with the rank words left off.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Οσιος Κρονανος O Εξ Ιρλανδιας (; - 617)» and the entry says he fell asleep in peace in 617. The page gives no year of birth and dates his life to the seventh century.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Κρονανός o εξ Ιρλανδίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates him «(; - 617)» and the entry is one sentence. It says he belonged to the company of Saint Kevin, whom the same day keeps, so there is a `related` row each way; it gives no monastery and no place beyond Ireland, and `locations` is left out. The corpus keeps nobody of this name. No hymn is printed.
